desc: 钢木框架大桌面电脑桌，占地小带抽收纳，居家安心办公
name: 现代钢木一体电脑桌款

shots.intent: 首屏以真实居家办公场景叠加两行大字主张，3 秒定调并赢取点击与停留。
shots.textZone: upper copy zone set on the calm wall area: teal capsule label 「{selling_point_1}」, two-line heavy charcoal headline 「{callout_1}」 at 40pt, thin teal underline, 18pt subtitle 「{callout_2}」, letter-spaced English micro-caption

shots.intent: 用凌乱书房的两格痛点放大焦虑，为后面的收纳与一体式设计铺垫。
shots.textZone: top center teal circular mark with a white exclamation mark and charcoal headline 「{callout_1}」 at 36pt; one teal label bar under each panel reading 「{callout_2}」 / 「{callout_3}」 with a small grey caption line; bottom transition headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 32pt with subtitle 「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 用 2×3 图标矩阵快速预告六大功能，建立「功能全」的第一印象。
shots.textZone: under each circle a charcoal label 「{callout_1}」–「{callout_6}」 at 16pt with a small letter-spaced English micro-caption

shots.intent: 白底大图加青绿胶囊标签，一秒传达「占地小、随处摆放」的核心卖点。
shots.textZone: top-left copy zone: two-line charcoal headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt with a thin divider and 16pt subtitle 「{callout_1}」; teal capsule under the product reading 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用 A+B=C 的组合图式讲清一体式设计，传递「一张顶两张」的价值感。
shots.textZone: charcoal labels 「{callout_1}」 / 「{callout_2}」 under the two cards; teal capsule 「{selling_point_1}」 above two charcoal benefit lines 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 at 16pt

shots.intent: 镜像视角加 01-04 编号卖点，逐条证明结构、圆角、钢架与板材工艺。
shots.textZone: top-left two-line charcoal headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt plus 16pt subtitle 「{callout_1}」; bottom row of four numbered rounded-rectangle callouts 「01.{callout_2}」 「02.{callout_3}」 「03.{callout_4}」 「04.{callout_5}」 with thin-line icons

shots.intent: 浅景深室内场景加底部容量图标条，证明桌面能装、场景百搭。
shots.textZone: top two-line charcoal headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt with 16pt subtitle 「{callout_1}」; bottom full-width dark charcoal rounded strip with four white thin-line icons joined by plus signs and short white labels 「{callout_2}」–「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 交替图文卡放大挡板、圆角、拉手三处细节，用微距质感证明做工。
shots.textZone: centered section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt with letter-spaced English micro-caption; each card carries a charcoal title 「{callout_1}」/「{callout_2}」/「{callout_3}」 with a short teal divider and two or three small grey caption lines

shots.intent: 俯视产品加尺寸标注与两列参数卡，一次讲清规格，消除买错尺寸的疑虑。
shots.textZone: centered headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt with English micro-caption; spec card with teal-dot labels 「{callout_1}」–「{callout_4}」 each paired with a value line 「{callout_5}」–「{callout_8}」; short dimension labels 「{callout_9}」 along the lines

shots.intent: 低角度产品大图加青绿 CTA 胶囊收口，把前面的信任推向下单动作。
shots.textZone: top center two-line charcoal headline 「{callout_1}」 at 36pt; teal capsule CTA button 「{callout_2}」 under the product

style.backgroundSystem: alternating flat pure-white #FFFFFF and light-grey #F2F2F3 infographic panels; the opening scene uses a soft blue-grey wall #C9D2D8 with a bright window and a light marble-vein floor #DCDCDC
style.iconSystem: thin-line charcoal icons inside soft white circles with subtle drop shadows; teal circular markers; numbered rounded-rectangle callout labels
style.lightingSystem: bright even diffused neutral 5500K light; soft contact shadows on scene shots; flat shadowless light on infographic panels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clean modern home-office furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF panels, light grey #F2F2F3 panels, charcoal #2D2D2D text, one teal accent #2CB0A5, with the product's light-oak wood tone #D8B98E appearing only on the product itself; neutral tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif with heavy two-line Chinese headlines in 「」, thin teal underline dividers, teal capsule labels, teal circular icon markers, numbered rounded-rectangle callouts and letter-spaced English micro-labels; alternating flat white and light-grey infographic screens plus one soft blue-grey wall home scene with a light marble-vein floor; bright even diffused neutral 5500K light, soft contact shadows on scene shots, flat shadowless light on infographic panels; thin-line charcoal icons inside soft white circles; product shown as a light-oak computer desk with white metal frame and white drawer unit at stable scale, props never covering the product; balanced full compositions where desk and copy share the frame; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented certifications or test data
style.presentationRules: product shown as a light-oak computer desk with white metal frame and white drawer unit at stable scale; props never cover the product; mirrored 3/4 angle allowed for detail variety
style.surfaceSystem: light-oak wood-grain desktop with white metal frame; light marble-vein floor in the scene; flat matte grey and white panels elsewhere
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; heavy two-line Chinese headlines 32-44pt wrapped in 「」, 16-20pt subtitles, 10-14pt labels; thin teal underline dividers and letter-spaced English micro-labels
